title: Prefill/Decode stratified kernel inspector and mitigation roadmap
creator: Miguel Torres
description: Investigate and mitigate intermittent latency/throughput cliffs observed during prefill-to-decode transitions across heterogeneous kernels (v2/v3). Build a small-footprint inspector that tags requests by shape/precision and emits a compact trace to help correlate kernel choice, memory layout, and decode pacing with end-to-end tail latency.
background: Since integrating FlashAttention v3 variants we’ve seen sporadic 95th+ tail regressions on mixed workloads where small prefill batches quickly switch into decode heavy phases. Existing profilers capture kernel-level metrics but lack request-scoped signals that join prefill shape with the decode kernel handoff. This makes root causing noisy multi-tenant interference and kernel oscillation hard.
proposed_solution: 1) Implement a lightweight Request Inspector that records: request fingerprint (shape, precision, token budget), kernel candidate list chosen by the selector, timestamped state transitions (prefill->decode), and memory workspace allocation sizes. 2) Add an adaptive backoff policy in the kernel arbiter that detects repeated oscillation and pins a conservative kernel for the session. 3) Surface compact traces in Console logs and a new telemetry cohort to drive automatic rollout hold if latency delta > 30%.
experiments: - Microbench harness: synthetic seed shapes (short prefill + long decode, long prefill + short decode) across CPU/GPU types. - Shadow probe rollout: enable Request Inspector on 5% traffic for 48h to collect cohorts. - Kernel pinning A/B: 50/50 split between default selector and pinned conservative kernel for oscillating cohorts.
telemetry_links: dashboards/internal/prefill_decode_strata | metrics: infra.kernel_switch_count, runtime.prefill_latency_p95, runtime.decode_latency_p95 | trace-sample: gcs://redwood-internal/traces/eng-246136/samples
decisions: - Build inspector as opt-in runtime flag to keep overhead <0.6% tail increment. - Use a rolling 10m window to detect oscillation: >3 kernel switches for same request fingerprint triggers pinning. - Conservative pinned kernel will be FlashAttn-v2 quantized variant for v3-incompatible shapes.
blockers: - Need a micro-allocator API change for exposing per-request workspace size (ENG-202420). - Legal review for trace retention policy when request fingerprints include customer prompt length (privacy).
acceptance_criteria: - Inspector collects representative cohorts with <1% added p95 latency in shadow mode. - Kernel pinning reduces oscillation SLO breaches by >=40% on tested cohorts. - Console shows cohort visualization and a one-click hold of rollout when delta exceeds thresholds.
implementation_notes: - Runtime: add inspector hook between selector and kernel launch; record minimal integer IDs and delta timestamps. - Storage: use compressed protobuf lines in existing telemetry bucket; avoid storing raw prompts. - Rollouts: start in dedicated clusters, then shadow in hosted to validate multi-tenant noise.
followups: - Schedule postmortem of any cohort with >50% regression and create remediation tickets. - Add e2e replay harness to reproduce oscillation outside production. - Evaluate integrating with Optimize advisor to recommend safe kernel mappings per customer workload.
